subject: Re: URGENT: Hosted API timeouts when using JSON Schema structured output
body:
From: Samir Qureshi <samir@northwindanalytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jul 29, 2025 at 9:12 AM
Subject: URGENT: Hosted API timeouts when using JSON Schema structured output

Hi Monica,

Were getting frequent timeouts when we turn on the JSON Schema structured output feature (same prompts succeed without it). This is blocking our POC.

Details:
- Endpoint: /v1/chat/completions
- Region: us-east
- Model: atlas-13b-instruct
- Structured output enabled with a fairly large schema (dozens of properties)
- Client timeout at 60s

Can you advise?

Thanks,
Samir

---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Qureshi <samir@northwindanalytics.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jul 29, 2025 at 9:27 AM
Subject: Re: URGENT: Hosted API timeouts when using JSON Schema structured output

Samir  thanks for the details. Looping in Support (Aisha) + Runtime (Diego).

A couple quick mitigations while we investigate:
1) Reduce max_output_tokens
2) Simplify the schema (avoid large anyOf/oneOf; reduce deeply nested arrays)

If you can share 23 failing request IDs or timestamps we can correlate quickly.

Best,
Monica
Customer Success
Redwood Inference

---

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Qureshi <samir@northwindanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jul 29, 2025 at 10:03 AM
Subject: Re: URGENT: Hosted API timeouts when using JSON Schema structured output

Hi Samir,

We have a related report from another customer and were actively investigating. Could you send 25 request IDs?

In the meantime, if tool-calling output is acceptable, that path tends to avoid the constrained decoding behavior that triggers the long tail.

Thanks,
Aisha

---

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Qureshi <samir@northwindanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jul 30, 2025 at 12:41 AM
Subject: Re: URGENT: Hosted API timeouts when using JSON Schema structured output

Samir  thanks. We correlated those requests and confirmed they are spending most of the time in the constrained decoding loop with your schema complexity.

Were applying a mitigation in us-east (increasing the internal structured-output step timeout for enterprise traffic) and will follow up once its live.

Workarounds that should help immediately:
- reduce schema complexity (especially anyOf/oneOf)
- set a tighter max_output_tokens

Well also publish a known-issues note so your team has a reference for best practices.

Diego
